scheme_name: Persons With Disabilities Scheme In Colleges: Financial Assistance To Visually Challenged Teachers
other_conditions: Must be a visually challenged permanent teacher working in a college that is covered under Sections 2(f) and 12B of the UGC Act
benefits_summary: Provides up to Rs.36,000 per year as a reader’s allowance and funds for Braille books, recorded materials, and other teaching and learning aids for visually challenged permanent teachers.
documents_required: Original bills submitted to the college
